Business Platinum Rewards Card earns 4.0% on travel, software, and media advertising and 1.5% on other purchases; cash equivalents, balance transfers, and fees do not earn; calculated on net purchases after returns/credits. [doc_business_credit_cards_business_platinum_rewards_card_002]

VERIFIED CUSTOMER: Amara Okonkwo, user_id 755bcb4d5d (identity verified 2/4 fields — DOB + phone — and logged 2025-11-14 03:40:00 EST).

ISSUE: Cash back under-awarded on Business Silver Rewards Card (opened 02/13/2025; base 10% travel/software, 1% other; 2x promo for first 6 months, 02/13/2025–08/13/2025). Three transactions confirmed short by recalculated amounts (points floored, 1 pt = $0.01):
1. txn_a8f1c2d3e403 — JetBlue Airways, 03/22/2025, $315.00, travel, posted 3,150 pts (10%) vs expected 6,300 pts (20% promo) → short 3,150 pts
2. txn_a8f1c2d3e410 — Southwest Airlines, 08/25/2025, $380.00, travel, posted 1,520 pts (4%) vs expected 3,800 pts (10%) → short 2,280 pts
3. txn_a8f1c2d3e411 — Zoom Video, 09/15/2025, $149.99, software, posted 600 pts (4%) vs expected 1,499 pts (10%) → short 899 pts
TOTAL SHORTFALL: 6,329 points = $63.29 (customer has this figure in their notes and expects to reconcile against it).
Note: 4% appears to have been applied to #2 and #3, matching the customer's personal Silver Rewards card rate rather than Business Silver.

ACTIONS TAKEN: Reviewed both card accounts and full transaction history; verified rates/exclusions via KB (Coursera and Microsoft 365 correctly earned 1% as named bonus-category exclusions; personal Silver transactions all correct). Customer submitted all three cash back disputes themselves via submit_cash_back_dispute_0589 and received confirmation IDs with status "SUBMITTED — queued for review":
- dsp_c16631293b89 (JetBlue)
- dsp_ebffb9d8483f (Southwest)
- dsp_4a1414aa6359 (Zoom)

REASON FOR TRANSFER / SYSTEM DISCREPANCY: get_user_dispute_history_7291(user_id 755bcb4d5d) returned "No transaction disputes found" on two separate calls, so none of the three confirmation IDs can be located agent-side. This may be because that tool returns only credit card disputes while cash back disputes live in the separate cash_back_disputes database — please confirm which is the case and verify the records against the cash_back_disputes queue. No rewards adjustment was applied: update_transaction_rewards_3847 is only permitted after a dispute is resolved and approved, and all three remain queued.

CUSTOMER REQUESTS FOR THE HUMAN AGENT:
1. Confirm all three dispute IDs are actually recorded against profile 755bcb4d5d and report where each one sits in review.
2. Provide a realistic review turnaround (no SLA for cash back disputes was found in the KB), and clarify what the customer must do to get the 6,329 pts / $63.29 credited after approval — specifically whether the correction posts automatically or whether they must call back / an agent must run the rewards adjustment.

Customer is polite, detail-oriented, and explicitly wants loose ends closed; no frustration or complaint expressed.
